title: How a Godly Man Talks About People Who Aren't in the Room
caption:
What you say about someone when they're not in the room is who you actually are. Not the version you perform to their face.

Next time the conversation turns toward someone who isn't there, notice the pull. Trade the update for a prayer. Guard what was told to you in trust: Proverbs 11:13 calls a gossip a man who betrays a confidence, and a trustworthy man the one who keeps it. If it's worth saying, say it to him.

The same guy everywhere starts with the same words whether he's in the room or not.
